messages:
mike: CI red on hosted-integ shards 15-19 — seeing 401s against Hosted API and some streaming parse errors. Logs: `ERROR auth: token validation failed` + `stream: unexpected EOF while parsing event`. Can someone trigger parallel reruns for 15-19? I don't have time to bisect right now.

jia: on it, triggering reruns for 15-19 now. quick q: any recent changes to auth header parsing or test client signing?

ci-bot: Rerun requested by @jia for jobs: hosted-integ/shard15, shard16, shard17, shard18, shard19. Starting parallel reruns. Links: https://ci.internal/runs/1864123456

alex: seeing flakes in tool-calling tests too (different shards). Quick grep in test helpers shows some tests sending `Authorization: Token <tok>` while runtime expects `Bearer`. Could be mismatch. @marie did runtime parsing change?

marie: we rolled out a stricter Authorization header parse last night (only accepts `Bearer `). That change was meant for a private deploy but the flag got enabled in the canary pool. Rolling it back now. If integ hits canary nodes they'll 401.

devops: isolating canary pool from integration pool now. Also suggest a small test-side tolerance to avoid CI blocking: accept both `Token` and `Bearer` temporarily. e.g. `if header.startswith('Token'): header = 'Bearer '+header.split()[1]` — would someone be OK pushing that to the test harness as a quick workaround?

jia: reruns done: shard15 PASS, shard16 PASS, shard17 FAIL (stream parse), shard18 PASS, shard19 FAIL (401). Last failing traces:
```
stream: unexpected EOF at line 1
auth: received "Token abc..." expected "Bearer"
```

alex: shard17 stream parse looks like a separate flake — partial frames. Could be client-side pacing. Try adding a tiny delay between websocket handshake and first chunk: `time.sleep(0.03)` in the test client and repro with `make integ-run SHARD=17`. I'll try locally.

mike: opening a small bisect for the stream parser failure (range main@a1b2..main@c3d4). Also merged a temporary test patch that accepts both auth prefixes and pinned canary off the integration pool. If anyone has failing artifacts from shard17 please upload to the CI run link above.

jia: :thumbsup: watching the CI. If we see more 401s or streaming EOFs I'll escalate to eng-oncall. Thanks for the quick triage everyone.
